**Statements : **

Some Rackets are Bats.

All Bats are Sticks. 

**Conclusions : **

I. All Rackets are Sticks.

II. Some Rackets are not Sticks. 

III. Some Sticks are Rackets.

options.text: Both conclusions I and III follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/155a1041529511c8a82529c2da29631abeabf93878ad2a4eaaf60a67b05d36d5.png] 

Conclusions : 

I. All Rackets are Sticks → False (As Some Rackets are Bats so, All Rackets are Sticks is definitely False as shown below)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c39cb4cc67ed9c88cec9c70b532213802367adaa5010545e3c052ed2f1ef8e54.png] 

II. Some Rackets are not Sticks → False (As Some Rackets are Bats and All Bats are Sticks so, Some Rackets are not Sticks is definitely False as shown below)

III. Some Sticks are Rackets → True (As Some Rackets are Bats and All Bats are Sticks so, Some Sticks are Rackets is True)

∴ Here Conclusion I and II does not form complimentary pairs because both are false and there is no possibility from given statements.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion III follows".**

questions.question:
Which two signs can be interchanged so as to balance the given equation?

8 - 13 + 32 ÷ 8 × 17 = 91
questions.solution:
**BODMAS RULE**: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb88bef4aa0b765af62684c28b54f6564aaca0126a1361c2b977043aaa34f788.png] 

Given equation is :** 8 - 13 + 32 ÷ 8 × 17 = 91**

Let's check each option,

**Option (1) : ** + and -

After the sign interchange, the equation is

8 + 13 - 32 ÷ 8 × 17 = 91

According to the **BODMAS** rule

⇒ 8 + 13 - __**32 ÷ 8**__ × 17 = 91

⇒ 8 + 13 - __**4 × 17**__ = 91

⇒ __**8 + 13**__ - 68 = 91

⇒ __**21 - 68**__ = 91

**-47 ≠ 91**

**LHS ** ≠ RHS** **

**Option (2) :** - and × 

After the sign interchange, the equation is

8 × 13 +__** **__32 ÷ 8 - 17 = 91

According to the BODMAS rule

⇒ 8 × 13 + __**32 ÷ 8**__ - 17 = 91

⇒ __**8 × 13 **__+ 4 -17 = 91

⇒ __**104 + 4**__ -17 = 91

⇒ __**108 - 17**__ = 91

**91 = 91**

**LHS = RHA**

**Option (3) : **+ and × 

After the sign interchange, the equation is

8 - 13 × 32 ÷ 8 + 17 = 91

According to the BODMAS rule

⇒ 8 - 13 × __**32 ÷ 8**__ + 17 = 91

⇒ 8 - __**13 × 4**__ + 17 = 91

⇒ __**8**__ - 52 __**+ 17**__ = 91

⇒ __**25 - 52**__ = 91

**-27 ≠ 91**

LHS ≠ RHS 

**Option (4):** ÷ and × 

After the sign interchange, the equation is

8 - 13 + 32 × 8 ÷ 17 = 91

According to the BODMAS rule

⇒ 8 - 13 + 32 × __**8 ÷ 17**__ = 91

⇒ 8 - 13 + __**32 × 0.47**__ = 91

⇒ __**8**__ - 13 __**+ 15.05**__ = 91

⇒ __**23.05 - 13**__ = 91

**10.05 ≠ 91**

LHS ≠ RHS 

Hence, the correct answer is** ****"- and × "**.

questions.question:
Which two signs and two digits can be interchanged so as to balance the given equation? 

75 ÷ 15 - 18 × 12 + 17 = 79
questions.solution:
By using **BODMAS RULE** :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/405899e33afa7cea06876af03ba07e51d778f7400e6a946ff811cea99575a40e.png] 

**Option 1) : - and ÷; 2 and 5**

**Given equation is : 75 ÷ 15 - 18 × 12 + 17 = 79**

**After interchanging the signs and digits in given equation the equation followed as : 7__2__ - 1__2__ ÷ 18 × 1__5__ + 17 = 79**

**⇒ 72 - __12 ÷ 18__ × 15 + 17 = 79**

**⇒ 72 - __0.66 × 15__ + 17 = 79**

**⇒ __72__ - 10 +__ 17__ = 79**

**⇒ __89____ - 10__ = 79**

**⇒ 79 = 79**

**LHS = RHS**

Option 2) : × and -; 2 and 5

Given equation is : 75 ÷ 15 - 18 × 12 + 17 = 79

After interchanging the signs and digits in given equation the equation followed as : 72 ÷ 12 × 18 - 15 + 17 = 79

⇒ 72 ÷ 12 × 18 - 15 + 17 = 79

⇒ 6 × 18 - 15 + 17 = 79

⇒ 108 - 15 + 17 = 79

⇒ 125 - 15 = 79

⇒ 110 ≠ 79

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : - and ×; 7 and 5

Given equation is : 75 ÷ 15 - 18 × 12 + 17 = 79

After interchanging the signs and digits in given equation the equation followed as : 57 ÷ 17 × 18 - 12 + 15 = 79

⇒ 57 ÷ 17 × 18 - 12 + 15 = 79

⇒ 3.352 × 18 - 12 + 15 = 79

⇒ 60.352 - 12 + 15 = 79

⇒ 75.352 - 12 = 79

⇒ 63.352 ≠ 79

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) : + and ×; 5 and 8

Given equation is : 75 ÷ 15 - 18 × 12 + 17 = 79

After interchanging the signs and digits in given equation the equation followed as : 78 ÷ 18 - 15 + 12 × 17 = 79

⇒ 78 ÷ 18 - 15 + 12 × 17 = 79

⇒ 4.33 - 15 + 12 × 17 = 79

⇒ 4.33 - 15 + 204 = 79

⇒ 208.33 - 15 = 79

⇒ 208.33 - 15 = 79

⇒ 193.33 ≠ 79

LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is **"- and ÷; 2 and 5".**
